faq.q: How do I place an order?
faq.a: Simply browse our website, select your desired product, click “Add to Cart,” and proceed to checkout. After successful payment, you will receive order confirmation details via email.

Digital products such as license keys, activation codes, and subscriptions are delivered electronically via email or on-screen confirmation after payment. Delivery is usually instant or within a short processing time.

Digital products are generally non-refundable once delivered. Refunds may only be approved if the key was not delivered, the key is invalid and verified by our support team, or you were charged twice. Please refer to our Refund & Exchanges Policy for full details.

faq.q: How long does hardware delivery take?
faq.a: Delivery times vary depending on location and product availability. Our team will provide estimated delivery timelines after order confirmation.

faq.q: Do your hardware products come with warranty?
faq.a: Yes. Most hardware products come with a manufacturer’s warranty. Warranty terms vary depending on the brand and product.

faq.q: What should I do if I receive a damaged or incorrect item?
faq.a: Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery and provide your order number, photos or videos of the item, and a description of the issue. We will investigate and provide a replacement, exchange, or refund if verified.

faq.q: How do I know which software version to buy?
faq.a: We recommend checking your operating system version, device compatibility, and the number of users or devices required. If unsure, contact our support team before purchasing.

faq.q: Do you offer installation or configuration support?
faq.a: Yes, we may offer setup or configuration support for certain products. Contact us for availability and pricing.

faq.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: We accept secure online payment methods. Available options will be displayed during checkout.
Yes. We use secure payment processing systems to protect your personal and financial information.

faq.q: Can I modify or cancel my order?
faq.a: Orders can only be modified or canceled before delivery. Digital products cannot be canceled once delivered.

faq.q: How can I contact customer support?
faq.a: Email: secureafricasolutions@gmail.com Phone/WhatsApp: +256 703 834 115 | +256 752 656594 Address: P.O. Box 34069, Kampala, Uganda, East Africa
